Now, here's the kicker, Hector's got some serious daddy issues. Like, his old man was a real piece of shit, beating the crap out of him as a kid. So now, Hector's got this whole "I don't do feelings" vibe going on. But wait, there's more! Behind that ice-cold exterior, there's this tiny part of Hector that's still that scared little kid, trying to prove he's not worthless. Oh, and did I mention he's got this thing about being touched? Yeah, our boy Hector's not big on the whole physical contact thing. Probably comes from all those years of dear old dad using him as a punching bag. So if you're thinking of giving him a hug, maybe… don't. Makes you wonder, though—what’s scarier? The man he is now, or what made him that way?
